subject: Make Fx0 default WPA2 hotspot settings work and verify a physical client
status: NetworkManager configuration installed and functionally tested; device package source updated, native APK build/install not performed

system.device_package_installed: device-lg-madai-1-r1 plus the tracked config file copied to its intended package destination

implementation.scope: Only profiles using the default PMF value on wcn36xx. Does not implement BIP/PMF support; explicit per-profile requirements retain NetworkManager precedence.

validation.before: Same hotspot profile with PMF default=0 failed to initialize AP; wpa_supplicant logged key setting validation failed and Failed to initialize AP interface. nmcli timed out at 20 seconds.
validation.after: Config reloaded without restarting NetworkManager; same profile still PMF default=0 activated successfully; independent USB client associated and received DHCP.
validation.physical_peer: RTL8188CUS USB adapter wlp0s20f0u4; host built-in wlo1 not changed
validation.security: WPA2-PSK, CCMP; PMF disabled through driver-specific default
validation.forwarding_topology: To avoid Linux delivering traffic locally between interfaces on the same host, the client requested phone AP address 10.44.0.1:29980. A temporary, port-specific phone DNAT rule forwarded that flow to USB host 172.16.42.2:29980. Existing NetworkManager shared-mode masquerading and forwarding carried the data. The host server saw source 172.16.42.1, confirming phone-side NAT.
static_checks: all device package source SHA-512 checksums match

cleanup: Removed temporary host USB-client profile and phone hotspot profile. Both radios returned to disconnected.
Removed temporary phone HTTP input exception and DNAT table; stopped both HTTP servers.
Retained only the tested driver-specific PMF config on the phone.
Verified host default route and /etc/resolv.conf match pre-test snapshots after every reconnect and after cleanup.
No audio work or tests performed.
limits: External DNS queries timed out in this setup, which has no usable upstream resolver; external DNS/Internet service not qualified.
Hotspot suspend/resume, power draw, long soak, second concurrent client and actual Internet backhaul remain unverified.
This does not add protected management frame support to wcn36xx.

Initial direct HTTP request was blocked by the phone input firewall and reached the 40-second timeout while finishing after a narrow test-port rule was added. Successful direct transfer was measured separately.
package_followup: Signed ARMv7 device-lg-madai-1-r2 built/installed, boot image verified and default hotspot startup passes after reboot; see 2026-11-06-hotspot-package-installed.json
